title: Public assets
description: The register of what the venture ships as it is, at public/assets.json (I-23, J-2, J-3, J-4): each file in public/ with its source, license and credit, facts read by code from its bytes, and alt text with who wrote it; remote images as links with a note in raw/sources/<id>/; and remote_hosts, the hosts an agent may fetch from. Checked by schema/check-assets.mjs. Version 0.x, unevaluated.

by.description: Who wrote it. An agent's alt text stays pending until a person confirms it in provenance

facts.description: Read from the bytes by code (schema/assets.mjs), never written by hand

remote_hosts.description: Hosts an agent may fetch images from (exact, or *.example.com); the platform fetcher refuses any other

source.description: Where it came from: who made it, or a URL

license.description: An SPDX id (CC-BY-4.0, OFL-1.1), owned (made by or for the venture), licensed (bought), or the restriction (all-rights-reserved)

credit.description: Who to credit; a missing credit fails the check

decorative.description: An image that says nothing, so it needs no alt text

origin_url.description: The remote work this is a copy of

design_system.description: The design system (brand design_systems id) this came from

remote.description: Remote images the venture links to rather than ships

id.description: The raw source holding the note: raw/sources/<id>/

fetched.description: Facts from a fetch by the platform; the original stays private in raw/sources/<id>/original.*

copy.description: Where a full copy was kept, only when the license allows it
